answer.text: A portfolio's return to its risk-free rate
A portfolio's return and risk to similar portfolios (similar mandate) managed by others
A portfolio to its own historical return
A portfolio to its inflation rate

explanation.text: The Logic: Peer-group analysis = compare portfolio to a universe of similarly-mandated portfolios. Percentile rankings help investors see relative positioning. The Trap: The other options describe different analysis lenses. Cross-Exam Context: APMI publishes such rankings; XXI-B tests purpose. Manager's Pro-Tip: Peer rank shifts dramatically with the classification choice — ensure the manager is being ranked vs true peers, not broadly-labelled groups.
